summary.headline: Heaven’s Dissolution and the Magi’s Star
summary.text: Astrological argument about the dissolution and renewal of heaven, challenging the claim that Cancer’s rising at creation signifies the universe’s destruction and discussing planetary periods and returns. The passage also examines the star of the Magi, scriptural testimony from Isaiah and Paul, and remarks attributed to Basil and John Chrysostom.
